styles.name: Arcade
styles.look: White pixel type, like an old game menu.
styles.motion: Short phrases, hard cuts. The comment keyword lands twice the size.

styles.name: Low Key
styles.look: Tiny quiet captions under a pinned title pill.
styles.motion: Each phrase builds one word at a time.
styles.bestFor: Talking straight to camera, story time

styles.name: Field Notes
styles.look: A quiet white book serif, sentence case.
styles.motion: Whole phrases fade in, each in a different open part of the frame.

styles.name: Anchor
styles.look: Bold clean white sans pinned in one spot.
styles.motion: Hard cuts. Numbers and key words take over the frame with a glow.

styles.name: Loud Lowercase
styles.motion: One word at a time. The number parks top left as a title.
styles.speaker: her

styles.name: Vanity
styles.look: Tall butter cream serif, key words in yellow italic.
styles.motion: One word at a time, with a small icon beside the thing you name.
styles.speaker: her

styles.name: Bubblegum
styles.look: One glowing pale pink word above your head, under a swashy pink title.
styles.motion: One word at a time. The title blurs in.
styles.speaker: her

styles.name: Moodboard
styles.look: Bold rounded line, thin italic line under it, small sparkles.
styles.motion: The italic line types itself out.
styles.bestFor: Aesthetic content and tips lists, faceless or on camera
styles.speaker: her

styles.name: Golden Hour
styles.look: Gold italic film subtitles, low in the frame.

styles.name: Spec Sheet
styles.look: Small wide white caps, big tilted yellow tags for numbers.
styles.motion: Words snap in with a streak of motion blur.

styles.name: Bold
styles.look: Heavy tight lowercase over your chest. The words that matter go giant behind your head.
styles.motion: Each word pops in as you say it.

styles.name: Cool Girl
styles.look: Small calm lowercase with one big butter yellow italic line and sparkles.
styles.motion: The small line builds, the italic line lands on the key word.
styles.speaker: her

styles.name: Cool Dude
styles.look: Tiny wide-spaced caps over one heavy serif word.
styles.motion: The serif letters rise into place one by one.

styles.name: Karaoke
styles.look: Wide caps on a frosted dark plate.
styles.motion: The word you are saying lights up yellow and pops.

styles.name: Signature
styles.look: Clean wide white caps. On the big moments a marker script signs over heavy cream italic caps.
styles.motion: Hard cuts, the script slides in and the caps pop.

styles.name: Keyword
styles.look: One clean tight lowercase line, the word that matters in yellow.
styles.motion: Words pop in as you say them. A key word alone goes bigger.
styles.bestFor: Everyday talking reels, the safe default

styles.name: Weight Shift
styles.look: One clean typeface. Thin for the lead-in, heavy black for the word that matters.
styles.motion: The thin line builds, the heavy word lands.

styles.name: Terminal
styles.look: Code-style type for the lead-in, one big serif italic word.
styles.motion: The code line builds, the italic word lands.

styles.name: Outline
styles.look: Tall condensed caps. The word that matters is drawn hollow.
styles.motion: The caps build, the hollow word lands.
